page · item_title · note_title · surrounding_text · method · model

Walk RRF-ranked list to k+1, k+2, ...

Audit row → Postgres (WORM via S3 lock)

red row in Dashboard · reason preview
No silent drops · client polls → 500 + reason
Contract. A value can ONLY reach the caller after verify_verbatim returns True. Every other path drops the candidate (retry next page) or drops the whole job (red in dashboard).

Degrade, never fabricate. LLM breaker open → deterministic primitive. OCR breaker open → page marked `no_text` and retrieval moves on. Job exception → store.mark_failed + visible reason. Never a silent "confident wrong answer".
